industries.label: Industry-agnostic
notes: Name owners, make handoffs explicit, and draw gates where work changes hands between teams.
Prefer the smallest diagram that answers the question; split large maps by audience.
watchFor: Committee ownership ('the team') instead of one accountable name

industries.label: SaaS / software
notes: Map the self-serve path end to end: discovery, signup, activation, habit, expansion.
Metering, limits, and feature gates are real business logic — draw them as gates.
watchFor: Acquisition machinery drawn with no retention evidence

industries.label: Finance / fintech
notes: Segregation of duties is structural: approver, executor, and reconciler are separate lanes.
Every money-moving edge needs an audit-trail artifact.
watchFor: Approval the same owner can bypass

industries.label: Healthcare
notes: Separate clinical ownership from administrative ownership on every lane.
Patient data edges respect consent, access, and disclosure as explicit gates.
watchFor: Data flows crossing boundaries without a consent node
Throughput pressure drawn into clinical decisions

industries.label: Manufacturing
notes: Separate quality control from throughput; inspection is a named gate.
Physical material flows and information flows are different edge kinds.

industries.label: Logistics
notes: Every leg names its carrier and handoff mechanism.
Exceptions (delay, damage, loss) are first-class paths, not prose.
watchFor: Status updates without a source system
